branch.name: Branch name
branch.intro: Offices of your business. Owners see every branch; each member sees all branches or only the ones you choose for them.
branch.crossBranch: Match clients with properties of other branches too
branch.crossBranchHint: Off: clients are matched only with properties of their own branch.

deal.title: Deals
deal.subtitle: Pipeline from inquiry to transfer, with commission
deal.deleteConfirm: Delete deal {{no}}? Its payments are removed too.
deal.emptyHint: Start a deal when a client is serious about a property.
deal.titlePlaceholder: e.g. 120 sq yd plot, Gulshan Block 13-D

negotiation.title: Negotiation
negotiation.empty: No offers yet. Record the buyer’s first offer to start the negotiation.

approval.setting: Closing a deal as won needs approval
approval.settingHint: Agents can request it; members with “Approve deal closings” confirm it.
approval.pending: Waiting for approval to close as won.

deal.noAdjustments: No adjustments. Use one to correct the expected commission (e.g. a discount agreed with the client) — payments are never edited.
deal.adjustmentHint: Positive to add, negative to reduce the expected commission. It is recorded with your name and shown in the audit log.
deal.disputeHint: Describe what is disputed (amount, party, terms). Managers are shown a banner until it is resolved.
deal.resolutionHint: How was it settled? Add an adjustment too if the amount changed.
deal.payoutApprovalSetting: Agent payouts must be approved before they are paid

finance.title: Income & expense
finance.subtitle: Office income, expenses and receipts. Commission received on deals is added automatically.
finance.emptyHint: Record office expenses like rent and utilities, or other income.
finance.deleteMessage: It will be removed from reports. Receipts attached to it stay in documents.
finance.autoIncome: Record commission received as income automatically
finance.autoIncomeHint: Each commission payment on a deal adds one income entry (never twice); removing the payment removes it.

agreement.title: Agreements
agreement.subtitle: Sale, rent and token agreements from templates, in English or Urdu, with every version kept.
agreement.renewalHint: Renewal follow-ups are added 30 and 7 days before the end date (also as phone reminders).
agreement.renewalsPlanned: {{count}} renewal follow-up(s) planned before the end date.
agreement.emptyHint: Draft a sale agreement, tenancy agreement or token receipt from a template.
agreement.noTextHint: Generate the text from the template.
agreement.editTextHint: Your changes are saved as a new version; earlier versions are kept.
agreement.signedCopyHint: Upload the scanned signed agreement here, then mark the agreement signed.
agreement.uploadFirst: Tip: upload the signed scan under "Signed copy" first to attach it.

brochure.title: Brochure
brochure.hint: A printable PDF or a 1080×1350 image for WhatsApp and social media, with your contact and a WhatsApp QR code.
brochure.confidential: Only the asking price is ever shown. Minimum and expected prices are never printed.
brochure.imageHint: The image is sized for WhatsApp status and Instagram (1080×1350).
brochure.needsInternet: Making a brochure needs an internet connection.

lead.title: Lead score
lead.campaignHint: Ad, listing or campaign the lead came from

reasons.BUDGET_NO_MATCHES: Budget known, but no matching listings yet
reasons.LOCATION_AREA_ONLY: Only a general area is known
reasons.NOT_CONTACTED_LONG: No contact for over a month
reasons.NEW_LEAD: New lead (less than a day old)

scoring.title: Lead scoring
scoring.hint: How much each factor counts towards the 0–100 score, and the scores at which a lead becomes hot or warm.

import.title: Import leads from Excel
import.hint: Use the template (Name and Mobile are required). Every row is checked like a normal entry: duplicates and invalid numbers are skipped and listed.

subscription.requested: Request sent — our team will confirm the change.
subscription.readOnly: Your subscription has ended, so the account is read-only. Renew to add or change records.
subscription.billingNote: Plans are activated by the Dalliqo team once payment is received (bank transfer, JazzCash or EasyPaisa).

automation.title: Automation rules
automation.hint: Dalliqo checks these every few minutes and notifies the right people once per situation.

HOT_LEAD_UNCONTACTED.title: Hot lead not contacted
HOT_LEAD_UNCONTACTED.hint: Alert the agent and managers when a hot lead is not called within this time.

LEAD_INACTIVE.title: Lead going cold
LEAD_INACTIVE.hint: Remind the assigned agent when a lead has had no contact for this many days.

PROPERTY_REVERIFY.title: Re-confirm listings
PROPERTY_REVERIFY.hint: Ask the listing agent to re-confirm availability with the owner after this many days.

LISTING_EXPIRY.title: Listing expiry warning
LISTING_EXPIRY.hint: Warn this many days before a listing’s availability date (listings always expire on the date).

DEAL_STUCK_NEGOTIATION.title: Deal stuck in negotiation
DEAL_STUCK_NEGOTIATION.hint: Notify the agents and managers when a deal stays in negotiation this long.

AGREEMENT_EXPIRING.title: Agreement expiring
AGREEMENT_EXPIRING.hint: Notify before a rental or sale agreement reaches its end date.

VERIFICATION_DUE.title: Re-verification & document expiry
VERIFICATION_DUE.hint: Remind before an approved listing is due for re-verification, and before uploaded documents (NOC, tax receipts) expire.

RENT_DUE.title: Rent due reminder
RENT_DUE.hint: Remind the lease manager this many days before rent falls due.

RENT_OVERDUE.title: Rent overdue
RENT_OVERDUE.hint: Alert the lease manager and managers when rent is this many days late.

platform.subtitle: Subscriptions of every business on Dalliqo

verification.disclaimer: Internal verification by your team only. It is not a government or legal confirmation of ownership.
verification.checklistLocked: Submit the listing to work on the checklist.
verification.uploadHint: Upload documents in the Documents tab with the matching category.
verification.nextHint: Leave empty for 6 months from today
verification.queueSubtitle: Listings waiting for document and site checks

rental.title: Rentals
rental.subtitle: Leases, rent schedules and collections
rental.emptyHint: Create a lease to generate the rent schedule and track collections.
rental.managementFeeHint: Recorded as income when rent is received
rental.allocationHint: Applied to the oldest unpaid months first; any extra is kept as advance.
rental.relist: Put the property back on the market

finance5b.title: Installment plans
finance5b.subtitle: Buyer payment plans — booking, down payment, installments and possession
finance5b.emptyHint: Create a plan when a buyer pays in installments; Dalliqo tracks every due date and flags late payments.
finance5b.noExternal: No outside shares — the full commission goes to the agency.
finance5b.externalHint: Shares paid to other dealers, referrers or branches come off the top, before agent shares. Percent is of the total commission.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.subtitle: Your website, inquiries, campaigns and WhatsApp in one place
marketing.noInquiriesHint: Publish listings on your website and share the link — every inquiry becomes a lead with a call-back follow-up.
marketing.campaignsHint: Give each ad its own link (?c=code) to see which spend brings real deals.
marketing.spendHint: Spent outside the books — expenses booked against this campaign in Income & expense are added automatically
marketing.codeHint: Used in links as ?c=code. Leave blank to generate.
marketing.deleteCampaign: Delete the campaign “{{name}}”? Leads keep their history.
marketing.how1: Choose a web address and switch the website on.
marketing.how2: Open a property and press “Publish” — only published, available listings appear.
marketing.how3: Owner details, plot numbers, floor prices and exact locations are never shown.
marketing.how4: Each inquiry becomes a lead assigned to the listing agent, with a call-back within the hour.
marketing.waCloudHint: Messages are sent from your business number and replies arrive as leads and activity.
marketing.waNeedsNumber: Enter your phone number id from Meta to send from your business number.
marketing.waNeedsPlatform: WhatsApp Business is not set up on this server yet, so messages open in WhatsApp on your device instead. The administrator needs a Meta access token, app secret and verify token.
marketing.waPhoneNumberIdHint: Meta Business → WhatsApp → API setup → Phone number ID
marketing.waComposeHint: Sent from your business number when WhatsApp Business is connected; otherwise WhatsApp opens with the message ready. Free text works within 24 hours of the customer’s last message.
marketing.headline: Headline on the website
marketing.publishHint: Only the price, size, area and photos are shown. Owner details, plot / unit number, minimum price and the exact location stay private.
marketing.siteOffline: Your website is switched off — turn it on in Marketing → Website.
marketing.portalClientHint: A private page where the client sees their deals, installment schedule, rent and receipts — no account needed.
marketing.portalOwnerHint: A private page where the owner sees their listings, verification, website views, inquiries and rent collected.
marketing.shownOnce: copy it now — it is shown only once
marketing.portalMessage: Assalam-o-Alaikum {{name}}, here is your private page with {{business}}: {{url}}
marketing.emailHint: You still get them in the app and on your phone.
marketing.waAccountIdHint: Meta Business → WhatsApp → API setup → WhatsApp Business Account ID (for templates)
marketing.noTemplates: No approved templates yet. Create them in Meta Business Manager, then sync. Templates let you message customers after 24 hours of silence.
marketing.freeText: Free text (within 24 hours of their last message)
marketing.assignListingAgent: Give inquiries about a listing to its agent first

assign.ROUND_ROBIN: Share in turn between selected agents

marketing.assignPoolFallback: In turn from the agents above
marketing.assignHint: Applies to website and WhatsApp leads. Inactive members are skipped automatically.

portal.clientIntro: Your deals, payment schedules and receipts with {{business}}.
portal.ownerIntro: Your properties with {{business}} — status, verification and interest.
portal.sent: Sent — your agent will get back to you.
portal.noMatches: No matching properties right now — your agent will add them as they come in.
portal.visitRequested: Visit requested — your agent will confirm the time.
portal.ownerThanks: Thank you — your agent has been told.

ai.title: Assistant
ai.subtitle: Ask about your clients, listings, deals and money — answers come from your own data
ai.notConfigured: The AI assistant needs an Anthropic API key on the server. Price estimates, forecasts and template descriptions still work.
ai.intro: Ask in English, Urdu or Roman Urdu. The assistant reads only what you are allowed to see. It can suggest follow-ups and notes — nothing is saved until you confirm.
ai.q1: What should I focus on today?
ai.q2: Which hot leads have not been contacted this week?
ai.q3: How much commission is expected next month?
ai.q4: Who owes us money and how late is it?
ai.placeholder: Ask a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
ai.privacy: Your question and the records needed to answer it are sent to Anthropic to generate the reply. CNICs and owner details are never sent.
ai.descriptionHint: Uses only the listing facts — never owner details or the plot number.
ai.descriptionIntro: Choose a language and press Generate. You can edit the text before saving it to the listing.
ai.sourceAi: Written by AI — check before sharing.
ai.sourceTemplate: Built-in template (AI is not set up).
ai.sourceRules: Rule-based summary (AI is not set up).
ai.briefIntro: A short summary of this lead, the next best step and a WhatsApp message you can send.
ai.forecastMethod: Commission is weighted by how likely each deal stage is to close; installments and rent are what is scheduled and still unpaid.
ai.q5: Schedule a call tomorrow with my hottest lead

ops.refundHint: Records a separate refund expense; the original income stays as it was. Up to {{left}} can still be refunded.
ops.targetsHint: Monthly targets. Leave blank for no target.

check.FRESH: Availability confirmed in the last 30 days

ops.subject: Subject
ops.noMaintenance: No maintenance costs recorded for this lease.
ops.portalHint: Controls what clients and owners can see and do through their private portal links.

portal.showMatches: Clients see matching properties and can save favourites
portal.allowPreferenceUpdates: Clients can update their budget and areas
portal.showDocuments: Show documents you share in the portal
portal.showOwnerInquiries: Owners see inquiries on their properties (first name only)
portal.showOwnerOffers: Owners see offers on their properties
portal.allowOwnerAvailabilityUpdates: Owners can confirm availability / ask for a price change

ops.portalShareHint: Clients / owners linked to this record see it in their portal. CNIC and title documents can never be shared.

pipeline.title: Deal pipeline
pipeline.hint: Choose the stages your team uses, rename them, and set how likely a deal at each stage is to close. The chance drives the commission forecast.
pipeline.label: Name (English)
pipeline.required: Inquiry, Won and Lost are always part of the pipeline. Deals already in a stage you switch off keep it until they move.

bulk.title: Bulk actions
bulk.deleteConfirm: Delete {{count}} selected records? They are removed from every list.

commissionRules.title: Commission rules
commissionRules.hint: Different default rates for some listings, for example rentals or plots. The first rule that fits a new deal is used; otherwise the two default rates above apply. Agents can still change the commission on each deal.
commissionRules.none: No rules yet. Every new deal starts with the default rates.
commissionRules.needCondition: Each rule needs a listing purpose or a property type.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.hint: Choose how long the audit log and the activity feed are kept. Older entries are deleted once a day. Clients, properties, deals, payments, agreements and documents are never deleted by this setting.

apiKeys.title: API access
apiKeys.hint: Keys let your own website or other software read and add records without signing in. A key acts for the person who created it, with only the permissions you tick, and cannot reach members, settings or billing.
apiKeys.notInPlan: API access is part of the Enterprise plan.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.expiryHint: Leave empty for a key that works until you revoke it.
apiKeys.createdHint: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it somewhere safe.
apiKeys.usage: Send it with every request in this header:
apiKeys.revokeHint: Software using this key stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
